answers.q1: pnpm is the package manager. The root package.json sets packageManager to pnpm@12.10.0, and the preinstall script runs `npx only-allow pnpm`, which rejects npm and yarn. Node must be ^20.19.0 || >=22.12.0. Install with: `pnpm install`. CI also runs `pnpm run build` before testing, and the unit tests may need it: `pnpm run build`.
answers.q2: `pnpm test`. This runs `pnpm test:unit && pnpm test-serve && pnpm test-build`, which is the vitest unit tests plus the playground e2e tests in serve mode and in build mode. CI also runs `pnpm run test-serve-bundled`, which `pnpm test` doesn't include. The e2e tests need Playwright's browser, installed with `pnpm playwright install chromium`. CI's steps are `pnpm run test:unit`, `pnpm run test-serve`, `pnpm run test-serve-bundled` and `pnpm run test-build`. If you only want the unit tests, run `pnpm run test:unit`.
answers.q3: `pnpm exec vitest run packages/vite/src/node/__tests__/config.spec.ts`. The root vitest.config.ts is the unit-test config and it includes `**/__tests__/**/*.spec.[tj]s`. Don't pass `-c vitest.config.e2e.ts`, which is the playground config. The equivalent through the package script is `pnpm run test:unit packages/vite/src/node/__tests__/config.spec.ts`.
answers.q4: Run these in order, as the CI lint job does. Run `pnpm run build` first. Then run `pnpm run lint:js`, which is `eslint --cache . --concurrency auto`. Then check formatting with `pnpm format && git diff --exit-code`, where `pnpm format` runs oxfmt and the diff fails if any file changed. The job also runs `pnpm run typecheck` and `pnpm run test-docs`. The full sequence is: `pnpm run build && pnpm run lint:js && pnpm format && git diff --exit-code && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test-docs`. The repo is not a git checkout here, so `git diff --exit-code` won't work in this directory.
answers.q5: No vendored directory is declared in the config files I read. Some things are generated or are tool output, so don't hand-edit them. `pnpm-lock.yaml` is generated by pnpm. `**/dist/` and `dist-ssr` are build output and are gitignored. `playground-temp/` and `temp/` are test scratch directories. `docs/.vitepress/cache` and `docs/.vitepress/.temp` are docs build caches. `packages/vite/LICENSE` is generated and gitignored. `.eslintcache` is a cache file. `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` is generated by the release changelog tooling (`merge-changelog`) and the release process. `**/*.snap` files are vitest snapshots, so regenerate them with vitest `-u`. The eslint config lists `**/fixtures/**` as ignored, and the test fixtures are intentionally odd. Edit them only when a test needs it.
